recognize_zh: 薄層抹片中有數個核圓、染色質細緻、胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞，旁邊有胞質粗顆粒的前驅細胞與一個胞質豐富淡染、核偏位的單核球樣細胞；單一視野只能看出芽細胞與顆粒球系異常，多系發育不良無法充分評估。
features: Blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Granulated precursor with coarse azurophilic granules (promyelocyte-like)
Monocytoid cell with eccentric folded nucleus and abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm (left)
Hypogranular cell with coarse chromatin (upper left) and a small lymphocyte (upper right)
Monolayer red cells with mild anisocytosis; no platelets conspicuous
describe_en: Thin smear area shows several blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, together with a coarsely granulated promyelocyte-like cell, a monocytoid cell with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm, and a small lymphocyte. The red cells are in a monolayer with mild anisocytosis. Definite multilineage dysplasia is not demonstrable in this limited field. Findings support an acute myeloid leukemia; the subclassification as AML with multilineage dysplasia requires evaluation of dysplasia across the whole aspirate.

ddx.vs: AMML requires ≥20% monocytic cells in addition to myeloblasts, confirmed by NSE staining, rather than a single monocytoid cell.
Lacks ≥50% dysplasia in two lineages and MDS-related cytogenetics.
APL shows a predominant population of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rods rather than isolated granulated cells.
